title: 第3章 开房治病疏通血管第4章 我不理你你偏要作死
content_zh:
眨眼间，到了下班时间。
张扬在路边简单吃了顿饭，来到预订的酒店，静静等待。
约莫八点，柳飘絮终于来了。
“柳主任，趴到床上。”
柳飘絮听话地趴到床上。
床垫被压成两个旋涡，腰部跟床之间居然还有空隙。
这规模太恐怖了，到底是吃什么长大的？
张扬压住内心旖旎，站到床边，双手轻轻落到她腰上。
咯咯！
柳桃絮突然翻身，躲了过去：“不行，太痒了，我受不了。”
“痒由心生，你别想就行了。”
在张扬的强迫下，她再一次趴到床上。
咯咯！
柳飘絮再次翻身，直接从床上滚到地上。
张扬无语了，他还是第一次见到身体这么敏感的人。
“让我缓缓，咱们先聊聊天，行不行？”
柳飘絮身痒还有一个原因，她心里有些害怕。
腰部不像肩膀，是比较隐私的地方，万一张扬按着按着动情了怎么办？
这里孤男寡女，他若用强，她是一点反抗能力都没有。
“你想聊什么？”张扬问。

“我听说，你跟一个叫夏薇的护士在谈恋爱是不是？”
张扬点了点头：“我们谈了两年，不过已经分了。”
柳飘絮很好奇：“为什么？”
“有一晚上夜班，她把我叫到一个空病房，对我进行表白，说对我对一见钟情。我开始对她没多大感觉，毕竟才刚认识，没想到第二天事情就传了出去。为了她的名声，我答应了，两人就这样在一起了。她性格比较传统，拒绝婚前同居，两年来，我们没有发生过任何关系，相敬如宾。直到昨天，我发现她早就被一个男人包养了。”
噗！
柳飘絮以为是一个美丽的爱情故事，没想到最后这句话闪了她的腰。
“对不起，我没笑你的意思，实在是忍不住。”柳飘絮赶紧道歉。
“没关系，看清她的人品就好了。”
随着聊天深入，气氛缓和多了，张扬见时机差不多，再次让柳飘絮趴到床上。
张扬双手先是落到她肩膀上，等她的身体没那么敏感，这才按腰。
果然有效，颈椎按完，手转移到背部的时候，柳飘絮就不酸痒了。
很快，柳飘絮就舒服地呻吟起来，她很紧张，身体绷得很直。
她有点后悔了，刚才也不知道脑子发什么神病，竟然答应了。
男人可都是下半身动物，万一他忍不住怎么办？
“放松一点，我是医生，有职业道德。”
张扬强压欲望，他很清楚，时机还远远不到。
如柳飘絮所说，她的腰部情况，比起颈椎严重得多。
腰椎间盘血液阻塞，还有神病轻微挤压。
张扬先用元气强行改变腰椎，让其复位。
紧接，处理神病线。

最后，才处理血液流通。
短短一个小时，张扬整个人都虚脱了，体内元气，几乎消耗殆尽。
“你的腰椎比我想象中还要严重，一次没办法彻底，至少还要两次。”
张扬停下手部动作，进洗手间洗手，顺便擦一下汗。
content_en:
In the blink of an eye, it's time to get off work.
Zhang Yang had a simple meal on the roadside, arrived at the hotel he had booked, and waited quietly.
At about eight o'clock, Liu Piaoxu finally arrived.
"Director Liu, lie down on the bed."
Liu Piaoxu obediently lay down on the bed.
The mattress was pressed into two vortexes, and there was actually a gap between the waist and the bed.
This scale is too scary. What did you eat when you grew up?
Zhang Yang suppressed his inner charm, stood beside the bed, and gently placed his hands on her waist.
Cackling!
Liu Taoxu suddenly turned over and hid: "No, it's too itchy, I can't stand it."
"The itch comes from the heart, just don't think about it."
Forced by Zhang Yang, she lay on the bed again.
Cackling!
Liu Piaoxu turned over again and rolled directly from the bed to the ground.
Zhang Yang was speechless. This was the first time he had seen someone with such a sensitive body.
"Let me slow down and let's chat first, okay?"
There was another reason for Liu Piaoxu's itching. She was a little scared.
The waist is not like the shoulders, it is a more private place. What if Zhang Yang gets emotional by pressing it?
There is only one man and one woman here. If he uses force, she will not be able to resist at all.
"What do you want to talk about?" Zhang Yang asked.
"I heard that you are in love with a nurse named Xia Wei, right?"
Zhang Yang nodded: "We have been talking for two years, but we have broken up."
Liu Piaoxu was curious: "Why?"
"One night during the night shift, she called me to an empty ward and confessed to me that she fell in love with me at first sight. I didn't feel much towards her at first, after all, we had just met, and I didn't expect that the news would spread the next day. For the sake of her reputation, I agreed, and the two of us got together. She has a more traditional personality and refuses to live together before marriage. In the past two years, we have not had any relationship, and we treat each other with respect. Until yesterday, I found out that she had been kept by a man."
Poof!
Liu Piaoxu thought it was a beautiful love story, but she didn't expect that the last sentence flashed across her waist.
"I'm sorry, I didn't mean to laugh at you, I just couldn't help it." Liu Piaoxu apologized quickly.
"It doesn't matter, just see her character clearly."
As the chat progressed, the atmosphere became more relaxed. Seeing that the time was almost up, Zhang Yang asked Liu Piaoxu to lie down on the bed again.
Zhang Yang put his hands on her shoulders first, and then pressed down on her waist after her body was no longer so sensitive.
Sure enough, it worked. After pressing the cervical vertebrae and moving the hands to the back, Liupiaoxu no longer felt itchy.
Soon, Liu Piaoxu began to moan comfortably. She was very nervous and her body was very straight.
She regretted it a little. She didn't know what was going on in her head just now, but she actually agreed.
Men are all lower body animals, what if he can't help it?
"Relax, I'm a doctor and have professional ethics."
Zhang Yang suppressed his desire, knowing very well that the time was far from coming.
As Liu Piaoxu said, her waist condition is much more serious than her cervical spine.
The blood in the lumbar intervertebral disc is blocked, and the disease is slightly squeezed.
Zhang Yang first used his vitality to forcibly change the lumbar spine to reset it.
Next, deal with the insane line.
Finally, blood circulation is dealt with.
In just one hour, Zhang Yang was completely exhausted, and the energy in his body was almost exhausted.
"Your lumbar spine is more serious than I thought. It can't be completely repaired once, at least twice."
Zhang Yang stopped his hand movements and went into the bathroom to wash his hands and wipe his sweat.
